CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_is_free_buy_event(p_buy_in_amount numeric, p_buy_in_fee numeric, p_tournament_type text, p_variant text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT COALESCE(p_buy_in_amount, 0) = 0
     AND COALESCE(p_buy_in_fee, 0) = 0
     AND upper(COALESCE(p_tournament_type, 'MTT')) = 'MTT'
     AND lower(COALESCE(p_variant, 'freezeout')) NOT IN ('spin', 'sng');
$function$
